models.label: Kimi (open weights)
models.description: Single cluster model. Weights are not loaded until the logical device (aggregate donor VRAM) is large enough. Inference stays stub until weights are published and the pool is ready.

weights.note: Pin redistributable open Kimi checkpoint URLs/hashes here when the public pool routinely exceeds min_pool_vram_mib. Until then agents only arm the cache.
